x-instructions: Keys prefixed with x- are parked config, not live settings; Claude Code ignores unknown keys, so this is our JSON-comment workaround. Keep this file secret-free; it lives in the PUBLIC dotfiles repo. NON-ANTHROPIC BACKENDS: the parked x-env Ollama profile that used to live here was retired on 2026-08-01, replaced by the per-process launchers in bin/ (claude-glm, claude-gpt, claude-ollama, claude-openrouter, all thin wrappers over bin/claude-run). Routing is now per process rather than a global settings flip, so a routed session and a plain Max session run side by side and this file never needs editing to switch. The audit tier decision that lived in the x-ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL-DECIDE-ME marker is ANSWERED and now recorded in bin/claude-run: routed profiles leave the fable tier deliberately unmapped so Servanda gates halt loudly rather than running a weak adversarial audit. See docs/plans/claude-route-launchers.md and docs/assessments/route-gates.md. AUTO MODE: an autoMode block (soft_deny plus a generated environment profile) was written into this file on 2026-09-09 and moved to .claude/settings.local.json, which is ignored via ~/.config/git/ignore. It does NOT belong here. ~/.claude is a symlink to this repo's .claude/, so the global settings path IS a tracked file in a PUBLIC repo, and the generated profile described a private repo's contents by path. gitignore cannot cover this file because it must stay tracked. Put machine-local or repo-scoped config in settings.local.json; Claude Code merges it over this file. ATTRIBUTION: attribution.sessionUrl is false on purpose. It suppresses the Claude-Session trailer that web and Remote Control sessions otherwise append to commits and PR bodies, and it flips the instruction the CLI injects into each session to its do-not-attribute variant, so the harness and CLAUDE.md agree instead of contradicting each other. A gitAttribution key sat here from 2026-02-17 looking like it did this job and was inert: no trace of it in CLI 2.1.250 through 2.1.258 or in the changelog back to 0.2.21. Do not re-add it. See commit 899282c and docs/claude-code-background-sessions.md.
